description: This Java class 'RetrieveThingsResponseSignalMapper' maps 'RetrieveThingsResponse' objects to protocol signals, performing validation, constructing topic paths, and enhancing payloads for response messages in the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter.

classes.name: RetrieveThingsResponseSignalMapper
classes.description: A mapper class that converts 'RetrieveThingsResponse' objects into protocol signals, extending core mapping behavior and implementing response signal mapping.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the response object by ensuring its class name ends with 'Response', throwing an exception if not.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new TopicPathBuilder based on the response's namespace, using a placeholder if namespace is absent.

methods.name: enhancePayloadBuilder
methods.description: Adds status and entity information from the response to the payload builder.
